Gagnon Securities Llc increased its stake in Suncor Energy Inc (SU) by 29.77%   Gagnon Securities Llc bought 68,942 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.40% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 300,550 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $10.53M, up from 231,608   Gagnon Securities Llc who had been investing in Suncor Energy Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $54.15 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.34% or $0.11   $32.56. About 3.11 million shares traded. Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) has risen 22.43%   outperformed by 5.73% the S&P500.

Desjardins Securities upgraded Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) on Thursday, December 1 to “Buy” rating. The stock has “Hold” rating by TD Securities on Thursday, November 16. The rating was upgraded by Citigroup to “Buy” on Thursday, June 23.
